positions.name: UnilateralErasureDirective
positions.frame: Is authority here being exercised by commanding the removal or suppression of what the group knows, rather than by deciding what to do next?
positions.why: Both expressions are flat imperatives commanding the erasure of specific institutional knowledge — a prior decision and a migration topic — without consultation, justification, or rationale. The shared directional read is authority enacted through unilateral erasure directives rather than through forward-looking decisions, performed in the same calm, matter-of-fact register with decision-grade conviction.
